genomes.name: Trend ensemble
genomes.hypothesis: Slow trend following on the most traded coins, sized by volatility and switched off when bitcoin's trend turns down, is the edge that survives fees (Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon 2025; Detzel et al. 2021; Han, Kang & Ryu 2023).
genomes.rules: Among the 30 most traded coins with a year of history: in a coin while at least half of nine breakout lookbacks (5 to 360 days) are on, each with a trailing stop at the midpoint of its range; out when fewer than a quarter are. Only enters while bitcoin's trend score is at least 0.5, and sells everything below 0.25. Size = 25% target volatility / the coin's 90-day volatility, times the trend score, capped at 35%; up to 3 coins. Checked on daily closes.

genomes.name: Weekly leaders
genomes.hypothesis: Among the largest coins, the strongest over three weeks and nearest their highs keep leading for about a week (Liu, Tsyvinski & Wu 2022; Fieberg et al. 2025 CTREND).
genomes.rules: Every Monday: rank the 30 most traded coins by 3-week return, closeness to the 7-day high and distance above the 20/50/100-day averages. Hold the top 4 weighted by inverse volatility; keep a holding while it stays in the top 8. Cash when bitcoin's trend score is under 0.5.
